parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the WAF ruleset. Call the [ListWafRulesets](~~2878359~~) API to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. Call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) API to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: If version management is enabled for the site, use this parameter to specify the version to modify. The default value is 0.
